scriptDraft.line: I tried making this whole TikTok in one tab instead of four. It worked. I'm annoyed.

Normally my content stack is ChatGPT for the script, an image gen tab for thumbnails, CapCut for the edit, and at least one more tool for voice or captions. That's four logins, four subscriptions, four context-switches per post.
So I gave MWM.ai a real task — same one I'd do on a normal Friday — and made it run inside one tab.
It's an AI creator workspace at create.mwm.ai. Bundles the script, the visuals, and the edit-ready output into one surface. Not magic. Just one tab instead of four.
Where it actually helps: idea-to-export is faster. Where it doesn't: you still have to know what you're making — it's a workspace, not a strategist.
If your stack is leaking subscriptions and tabs, link's in bio. Worth thirty minutes of your time to see if it consolidates yours too. #mwmai
